summary: End-to-end testing of Scouting Platform (Scouts of Armenia). Backend: 30 pytest cases across auth, chapters, members, badges (progress+award+notify), programs, attendance, newsletters, announcements, notifications, stats (national/chapter/scout), audit, user role, search. Fixed 1 backend 500 bug (POST /api/programs/{id}/duplicate returned raw dict containing MongoDB ObjectId after insert_one -> now cleaned). Frontend: verified login for all 3 role types (admin/chapter_admin/scout), language toggle switches sidebar EN<->Armenian, role-based nav correctly hides Members/Attendance/Administration for scouts, Members CSV export downloads members.csv, Programs detail shows schedule/activities, Calendar renders month grid with clickable program pills, Badges page renders 15 badges, My Progress opens badge detail dialog. All 22 explicit test items in the review pass. Final: 30/30 backend + all frontend flows PASS.

minor.issue: Returned 500 because response dict contained mutated _id ObjectId after insert. FIXED by wrapping return in clean().

issues: Recharts warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' logged in console on initial render (cosmetic, chart renders correctly after layout stabilizes)

action_items: No blocking action items. Optional: silence Recharts width/height warning by giving ResponsiveContainer explicit min dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1100 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, chapters, members, badges, programs, etc.) for maintainability.

CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=False is fine for Bearer flow but note the httpOnly cookies set in login/register won't be sent cross-origin under this config; frontend uses Bearer so this is acceptable.
duplicate_program (fixed) is an example of a pattern risk: any endpoint returning a dict after insert_one must call clean() to strip _id. Consider a helper that inserts and returns clean copy.
GET /api/announcements builds $or query; if user has no chapter_id, list is still fine since $or begins with chapter_id:None — OK.
get_current_user chains cookie/session/bearer — good; ensure JWT_SECRET is rotated in production.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green after duplicate_program fix. If main agent modifies /api/programs endpoints or any endpoint that inserts+returns a document, ensure clean() is used to strip Mongo _id. Frontend fully functional with the 3 seeded role accounts.
rca of the issue: duplicate_program: The endpoint fetched a program with projection {_id:0}, added new program_id/title/created_at, then called insert_one(p). Motor's insert_one mutates the passed dict by injecting an ObjectId '_id'. The function then returned p, which now contained a non-JSON-serializable ObjectId, causing FastAPI's jsonable_encoder to raise TypeError. Fix: return clean(p) which pops '_id'. Reproduction: POST /api/programs/{any_valid_id}/duplicate -> 500 before fix, 200 with copy after fix.
